operations.description: Deletes a Amazon GuardDuty detector specified by the detector ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete detector [PATH] detector [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] delete detector response

operations.description: Deletes the filter specified by the filter name.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete filter [PATH] detector filter [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector filter headers id name security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] delete filter response

operations.description: Deletes the IPSet specified by the IPSet ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete ip set [PATH] detector ipset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id ip security set sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] delete ip response set

operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete threat intel set [PATH] detector threatintelset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id intel security set sha signature signed threat token x [SCHEMA] delete intel response set threat

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list detectors [PATH] detector [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] detector detectors id ids list response string

operations.description: Retrieves an Amazon GuardDuty detector specified by the detectorId.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] detector [PATH] detector [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] detector finding frequency map publishing response status string tag value

operations.description: Returns a paginated list of the current filters.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list filters [PATH] detector filter [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] filter filters list name names response string

operations.description: Retrieves the IPSet specified by the IPSet ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] ip set [PATH] detector ipset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id ip security set sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] format ip location map name response set status tag value

operations.description: Provides the details for the GuardDuty master account associated with the current GuardDuty member account.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] master account [PATH] detector master [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account id master response string

operations.description: Lists details about all member accounts for the current GuardDuty master account.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list members [PATH] detector member [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz associated content credential date detector headers id max next only results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account detector email id list member members response string

operations.description: Lists the ThreatIntelSets of the GuardDuty service specified by the detector ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list threat intel sets [PATH] detector threatintelset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] ids intel list response set sets string threat

operations.description: Retrieves the ThreatIntelSet that is specified by the ThreatIntelSet ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] threat intel set [PATH] detector threatintelset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id intel security set sha signature signed threat token x [SCHEMA] format intel location map name response set status tag threat value

operations.description: Lists all GuardDuty membership invitations that were sent to the current AWS account.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list invitations [PATH] invitation [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account id invitation invitations list response string

operations.description: Returns the count of all GuardDuty membership invitations that were sent to the current member account except the currently accepted invitation.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] invitations count [PATH] invitation count [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] count integer invitations response

operations.description: Lists tags for a resource. Tagging is currently supported for detectors, finding filters, IP sets, and Threat Intel sets, with a limit of 50 tags per resource. When invoked, this operation returns all assigned tags for a given resource..
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list tags for resource [PATH] tags [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz arn content credential date headers resource security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] for list map resource response tag tags value

operations.description: Creates a single Amazon GuardDuty detector. A detector is a resource that represents the GuardDuty service. To start using GuardDuty, you must create a detector in each region that you enable the service. You can have only one detector per account per region.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create detector [PATH] detector [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] create detector id response tag value

operations.description: Updates an Amazon GuardDuty detector specified by the detectorId.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update detector [PATH] detector [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] detector response update

operations.description: Creates a filter using the specified finding criteria.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create filter [PATH] detector filter [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] condition create criterion eq equals filter integer long name neq not response tag value

operations.description: Updates the filter specified by the filter name.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update filter [PATH] detector filter [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector filter headers id name security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] condition criterion eq equals filter integer long name neq not response update

operations.description: Lists Amazon GuardDuty findings for the specified detector ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] list findings [PATH] detector findings [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id max next results security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] by condition criterion eq equals finding findings id ids integer list long neq not order response string

operations.description:
Archives GuardDuty findings specified by the list of finding IDs.

Only the master account can archive findings. Member accounts do not have permission to archive findings from their accounts.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] archive findings [PATH] detector findings archive [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] archive finding findings id response

operations.description: Generates example findings of types specified by the list of finding types. If 'NULL' is specified for findingTypes, the API generates example findings of all supported finding types.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create sample findings [PATH] detector findings create [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] create finding findings response sample type

operations.description: Marks specified Amazon GuardDuty findings as useful or not useful.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update findings feedback [PATH] detector findings feedback [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] feedback finding findings id response update

operations.description: Describes Amazon GuardDuty findings specified by finding IDs.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] findings [PATH] detector findings [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] by double finding findings id order resource response service string type

operations.description: Lists Amazon GuardDuty findings' statistics for the specified detector ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] findings statistics [PATH] detector findings statistics [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] by condition count criterion eq equals finding findings integer long neq not response severity statistic statistics type

operations.description: Unarchives Amazon GuardDuty findings specified by the list of finding IDs.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] unarchive findings [PATH] detector findings unarchive [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] finding findings id response unarchive

operations.description: Creates a new IPSet - a list of trusted IP addresses that have been whitelisted for secure communication with AWS infrastructure and applications.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create ip set [PATH] detector ipset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] create ip response set string tag value

operations.description: Updates the IPSet specified by the IPSet ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update ip set [PATH] detector ipset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id ip security set sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] ip response set update

operations.description: Accepts the invitation to be monitored by a master GuardDuty account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] accept invitation [PATH] detector master [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] accept invitation response

operations.description: Disassociates the current GuardDuty member account from its master account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] disassociate from master account [PATH] detector master disassociate [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account disassociate from master response

operations.description: Creates member accounts of the current AWS account by specifying a list of AWS account IDs. The current AWS account can then invite these members to manage GuardDuty in their accounts.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create members [PATH] detector member [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts create detail email id members response string unprocessed

operations.description: Deletes GuardDuty member accounts (to the current GuardDuty master account) specified by the account IDs.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] delete members [PATH] detector member delete [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts delete id members response string unprocessed

operations.description: Disassociates GuardDuty member accounts (to the current GuardDuty master account) specified by the account IDs.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] disassociate members [PATH] detector member disassociate [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts disassociate id members response string unprocessed

operations.description: Retrieves GuardDuty member accounts (to the current GuardDuty master account) specified by the account IDs.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] members [PATH] detector member [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts detector email id member members response string unprocessed

operations.description: Invites other AWS accounts (created as members of the current AWS account by CreateMembers) to enable GuardDuty and allow the current AWS account to view and manage these accounts' GuardDuty findings on their behalf as the master account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] invite members [PATH] detector member invite [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts id invite members response string unprocessed

operations.description: Re-enables GuardDuty to monitor findings of the member accounts specified by the account IDs. A master GuardDuty account can run this command after disabling GuardDuty from monitoring these members' findings by running StopMonitoringMembers.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] start monitoring members [PATH] detector member start [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts id members monitoring response start string unprocessed

operations.description: Disables GuardDuty from monitoring findings of the member accounts specified by the account IDs. After running this command, a master GuardDuty account can run StartMonitoringMembers to re-enable GuardDuty to monitor these members’ findings.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] stop monitoring members [PATH] detector member stop [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts id members monitoring response stop string unprocessed

operations.description: Create a new ThreatIntelSet. ThreatIntelSets consist of known malicious IP addresses. GuardDuty generates findings based on ThreatIntelSets.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create threat intel set [PATH] detector threatintelset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] create intel response set string tag threat value

operations.description: Updates the ThreatIntelSet specified by ThreatIntelSet ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update threat intel set [PATH] detector threatintelset [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date detector headers id intel security set sha signature signed threat token x [SCHEMA] intel response set threat update

operations.description: Declines invitations sent to the current member account by AWS account specified by their account IDs.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] decline invitations [PATH] invitation decline [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts decline id invitations response string unprocessed

operations.description: Deletes invitations sent to the current member account by AWS accounts specified by their account IDs.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] delete invitations [PATH] invitation delete [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz content credential date headers security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] account accounts delete id invitations response string unprocessed

operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] tag resource [PATH] tags [PARAMS] 256 algorithm amz arn content credential date headers resource security sha signature signed token x [SCHEMA] resource response tag value
